caption: The drawing depicts a wooden structure resembling a coffin or crib with turned balusters on the sides and four sturdy, rounded legs. The structure is colored in different shades of brown, indicating wood grain, with details rendered in darker and lighter tones to show texture and variation in the material. Inside the coffin, there is a human-like figure representing Christ, draped in white cloth and decorated with additional colored fabrics and an intricate pillow under its head. The head of the figure is painted with facial features, and part of the fabric covering the figure has a floral or ornamental pattern in pink, yellow, and green. A small keyhole and clasp are present on one of the coffin’s sides. The top of the structure has angled slats or rods set diagonally, and the ends of the box feature carved wooden handles. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, detailed inset drawing of the same object, showing it from a different angle with emphasis on the lid and side structure. Annotated text in the bottom left portion of the drawing provides the name "Penitente Santo Entierro," lists dimensions, and credits the drawing to Eldora P. Loranzini, dated August 1, 1951, in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery depicted.
title: Wooden Coffin and Penitente Santo Entierro (Penitent Saint in Earth)
